newFeatures.title: Excel Add-in v0.4.0
description: The new version `v0.4.0` of the _Excel Add-in_ is available, and it supports the new **Business Glossary**: terms can now be pulled, enriched, and pushed from an Excel worksheet.
Check the [changelog](/docs/next/products/data_catalog/excel_add_in/changelog) for the full list of changes.

newFeatures.title: Custom Fields
description: Items can now be enriched with **Custom Fields**: typed, validated metadata that extends an Item Type without modifying its native schema — ideal for business or governance attributes that aren't covered out of the box. See the [Custom Fields documentation](/docs/next/products/catalog/basic-concepts/custom-fields) for the full workflow.

improvements.title: Clearer `ibdm`-to-Catalog wiring guidance
description: The [connector installation guidelines](/docs/requirements/installation-guidelines/catalog/connectors/00_overview) now clarify `MIA_CATALOG_ENDPOINT`'s expected shape, when `MIA_CATALOG_CUSTOM_SCOPE` needs to be set, and the exact scopes required on-prem vs. on the Mia-Platform PaaS.

improvements.title: Role-based permission management
description: Improved the [Administration](/docs/next/products/mia-platform-suite/rbac-management) UX for Organization Admins and Tenant Admins.

improvements.title: User Profile page
description: Every user now has a [Profile page](/docs/next/products/mia-platform-suite/rbac-management#profile) listing their tenants, groups, and effective roles.

newFeatures.title: AI Gateway & MCP Gateway
description: AI Foundry becomes a governed control plane for models and AI tools: the **AI Gateway** is a single proxy for LLM traffic with cost tracking, caching, guardrails/policies, and observability, while **MCP Federation** unifies multiple MCP servers behind one Foundry-governed endpoint with a federated registry and centralized discovery.

improvements.title: Improved yaml schema validation for Helm charts
description: The chart editor of Charts section in Design Area now validates `values.yaml` live against each chart's schema using the official `monaco-yaml` engine — including subchart dependencies from `Chart.yaml` — replacing the previous custom validation logic.

improvements.title: Authentication Service v3.14.0
description: The new version `v3.14.0` of the _Authentication Service_ is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.
Check the [changelog](/docs/next/runtime-components/plugins/authentication-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

improvements.title: Client Credentials v3.5.0
description: The new version `v3.5.0` of the _Client Credentials_ service is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.
Check the [changelog](/docs/next/runtime-components/plugins/client-credentials/changelog) for the full list of changes.
